title: Cofibrant resolution preserving a poset filtration
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and the Dwyer--Kan model structure of [lem-coef-simplicial-inversion-universal-property], and Kan fibrations and weak equivalences of simplicial sets as in [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Fix containing universes. Let $A$ be a small partially ordered set and $C$ a small simplicial category with a function $d:\operatorname{Ob}C\to A$ such that $C(x,y)=\varnothing$ whenever $d(x)\nleq d(y)$. For $a\in A$, let $C_{\leq a}$ be the full simplicial subcategory on objects $x$ with $d(x)\leq a$; inclusions define an ordinary diagram $A\to\mathrm{sCat}$. Suppose $\mathrm{sCat}^{A}$ has the projective model structure, with objectwise weak equivalences and fibrations. Then there is a simplicial functor $f:C'\to C$, bijective on objects, such that each map
$$C'(x,y)\longrightarrow C(fx,fy)$$
is a trivial Kan fibration, $C'(x,y)=\varnothing$ if $d(fx)\nleq d(fy)$, and the diagram $a\mapsto C'_{\leq a}$ is projectively cofibrant. Here $C'_{\leq a}$ is the full subcategory on $d(fx)\leq a$, and projectively cofibrant means that its map from the initial diagram has the left lifting property against every objectwise trivial fibration of diagrams. In particular $f$ and all $C'_{\leq a}\to C_{\leq a}$ are Dwyer--Kan equivalences. No filteredness, well-foundedness, nonemptiness or existence of a largest element is assumed for $A$.
